title: Visualization of Bacteria in Tick Gut Using Whole-Mount Fluorescence In Situ Hybridization
author: Hodžić, Kunert, et al.

steps.title: Prepare reagents and equipment
steps.instruction: Preheat the water bath and washing buffer to 48 °C, prepare fresh Milli‑Q water and keep it on ice, and perform all subsequent steps under a fume hood.

steps.title: Remove hybridization buffer
steps.instruction: Carefully remove as much hybridization buffer as possible from the microcentrifuge tube and dispose of it according to institutional safety regulations.

steps.title: Wash sample at 48 °C
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of pre‑heated washing buffer to the sample, place the tube in a floating rack and submerge it in the 48 °C water bath for 30 min, gently inverting the tube every 10 min while keeping the gut tissue fully submerged.

steps.title: Discard washing buffer
steps.instruction: Remove the washing buffer under the fume hood and dispose of it according to institutional safety regulations.

steps.title: PBS incubation
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of 1× PBS to the sample and incubate in the dark at 20 °C–22 °C for 15 min.

steps.title: Stain with DAPI
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of DAPI solution (10 µg/mL) to the sample and incubate for 8 min at 20 °C–22 °C in the dark.

substeps.instruction: Discard the DAPI solution and rinse the sample with 1 mL of ice‑cold Milli‑Q water.
Remove the rinse water under the fume hood and dispose of it according to institutional safety regulations.

steps.title: Transfer gut tissue to slide
steps.instruction: Trim the end of a 1,000 µL pipette tip to widen its opening, aspirate the gut tissue with the remaining liquid, transfer the tissue to a reaction well on a glass slide, and remove excess water from the well with a 20 µL pipette.

steps.title: Mount tissue with antifade
steps.instruction: Place a drop of Citifluor AF1 antifade reagent between each reaction well, cover with a 24 × 60 mm coverslip avoiding air bubbles; optionally add DAPI to the antifade mounting medium during slide preparation.

steps.title: Store mounted slides
steps.instruction: Store the prepared slides at 4 °C for up to 24 h before microscopy.
